title: Symbiosis Belt Role Specification 0.1
description: Machine-readable human-role register for the belt. Every role carries qualifications, authority, an absence prohibition, and an incompatibility list. Roles are concept-grade governance options, not confirmed agencies.

absence_prohibition.description: What must not happen while this role is vacant: the linked node must not open or must fall back to its non-AI baseline.

incompatible_with.description: Roles that the same party must not hold simultaneously.
